xBRIEFInfo.description: Plan for PAN-3927: pan inspect residue: lint-prompts.sh requires the deleted verb in the work-agent item loop

plan.title: pan inspect residue: lint-prompts.sh requires the deleted verb in the work-agent item loop
plan.author: agent:claude-fable-5-1

narratives.Problem: The PAN-3917 cut deleted `pan inspect` and the per-item inspection gate, but `scripts/lint-prompts.sh` (check_item_order_file, lines 38-68) still REQUIRES a `pan inspect` step after `pan task done` in both work-agent item loops, so the prompts could not be cleaned without turning `npm run lint` red. `src/lib/cloister/prompts/work.md:251` and `roles/work.md:68` therefore still tell agents to run a verb that exits 'unknown command' and then wait for a verdict that never arrives. Both loops also instruct `pan task done --reason`, which commander rejects as an unknown option, and neither mentions the `Item: <item-id>` trailer that `pan task done` actually requires on a pushed commit. `src/lib/cloister/prompts/inspect-agent.md` is a dead template with no renderer that still references `pan inspect`, pinned only by two tests and two docs.
narratives.Proposal: Retarget the lint's item-loop-order check to the surviving invariant (the `git push` step precedes the `pan task done` step) first, which is green against today's prompts. Then rewrite both item loops to the foreman shape already documented in sync-sources/agents/pan-work-agent.md: next, claim, implement, commit with `Item: <item-id>` trailer, push, `pan task done` with no `--reason`, plus one sentence that `requiresInspection` is a tier-supervisor subscription signal. Update the role-definitions test to the new shape. Then seal the lint by adding `pan inspect` to the forbidden-string check with a self-test case. Finally delete inspect-agent.md, the two tests that read it, and its two doc listings (docs/BUILD.md, CONTRIBUTING.md). Every commit keeps `npm run lint:prompts` green.
narratives.NonGoals:
- Removing the surviving `work.inspect` / `work.inspect-deep` sub-role slots or `inspect_agent` specialist config (src/lib/config-yaml/roles.ts:44, src/lib/router-config.ts:77, src/lib/settings-api.ts:317, src/lib/cloister/specialists-spawn.ts:11-12, src/dashboard/server/routes/specialists/project-routes.ts:653, src/lib/cloister/config.ts:194,216,228,464) or the 'inspect-agent' members of specialist-name unions; that is a separate config-residue follow-up.
- Editing docs/WORK-TYPES.md:59, CHANGELOG.md:40, docs/THE-CUT.md, docs/prds/**, docs/audits/**, docs/workflow-orchestration-enhancement-proposal.md, or vbrief/specification.vbrief.json (history and design records).
- Editing tests/unit/lib/overdeck/no-loss-matrix.ts rows 310 and 816 (a test consumes the matrix; its rows record the cut's dispositions).
- Touching sync-sources/agents/pan-work-agent.md (already correct), src/lib/cloister/work-agent-prompt.ts:580 (the word 'inspection' there means review), sync-sources/skills/pan-task/SKILL.md (already documents the trailer and no --reason), sync-sources/skills/write-xbrief/SKILL.md:141, or docs/XBRIEF.md:354 (already post-cut).
- Changing any `pan task` CLI flag or behavior.
- Rewriting other sections of work.md beyond the block at lines 231-252 and the two bullets at 290 and 297.

autoDecisions.summary: The linted item-loop invariant becomes 'git push step precedes pan task done step' instead of 'pan task done precedes pan inspect'.
autoDecisions.rationale: The old ordering only mattered so the inspector could diff from a post-done checkpoint; with the gate gone it has no meaning. Push-before-done is the invariant both prompts already state in prose and that `pan task done` itself enforces via requirePushed, so it is the one worth keeping mechanically checked.

autoDecisions.summary: Delete src/lib/cloister/prompts/inspect-agent.md rather than rewrite it.
autoDecisions.rationale: grep shows no renderer or spawn path reads it in src/ (only two tests and two doc listings); the build copies prompts by glob; docs/THE-CUT.md FR-14 says the gate is dropped outright. A prompt for a specialist that cannot run is residue.

autoDecisions.summary: Fix `pan task done --reason` (unknown option) and add the `Item: <item-id>` trailer to both loops in the same rewrite.
autoDecisions.rationale: These are the same numbered steps being rewritten; commander verifiably rejects --reason and pan task done requires the trailer (src/cli/commands/task.ts:133). sync-sources/agents/pan-work-agent.md already carries the correct shape to converge on.

autoDecisions.summary: Keep `pan task next` as step 1 of both loops.
autoDecisions.rationale: The verb exists (src/cli/commands/task.ts:164) and both prompts use it today; pan-work-agent.md omits it but nothing is gained by dropping it.

autoDecisions.summary: Documentation scope is docs/BUILD.md and CONTRIBUTING.md only, folded into the deletion item.
autoDecisions.rationale: Those two files list the template being deleted. No Mintlify .mdx page mentions pan inspect; docs/WORK-TYPES.md and CHANGELOG.md describe specialist config and history that this issue leaves alone.

autoDecisions.summary: Sequence lint retarget first, prompt rewrites second (in parallel), lint seal third, deletion last.
autoDecisions.rationale: Push already precedes pan task done in both prompts, so the retargeted rule is green immediately; the pan inspect ban can only land after both prompts are clean. This keeps every commit green on npm run lint:prompts.

items.title: Retarget lint-prompts item-loop-order check to push-before-done

narrative.Action: In scripts/lint-prompts.sh check_item_order_file (lines 38-68): replace the `inspect_step` capture with `push_step` (first numbered step containing `git push`), keep `done_step`, and print 'ok' only when push_step < done_step; change the failure message to 'item-loop-order: $file has pan task done not after git push ($result)'. In write_passing_fixture remove the fixture lines '7. read metadata', '8. skip if false', '9. pan inspect ISSUE --item item' from the work.md fixture and '7. read metadata', '8. pan inspect ISSUE --item item' from the roles/work.md fixture so each ends at '6. pan task done ISSUE item'. Replace the item-loop-order self-test mutation so it swaps '5. git push\n6. pan task done ISSUE item' with '5. pan task done ISSUE item\n6. git push' in the roles/work.md fixture. Do NOT add a pan inspect forbidden-string yet (that is w4). See PRD W1 for the exact before/after awk block.

narrative.Action: roles/work.md: (1) line 3 description becomes 'Overdeck work role — claims tasks, writes code, commits one item per commit with an Item trailer, and pushes before closing each item.'; (2) in '## Per-Task Workflow' step 4 gains ', with the body line `Item: <item-id>`', step 6 becomes '`pan task done <ISSUE-ID> <item-id>` — verifies the pushed commit carries the `Item:` trailer and records completion in the continue file. It takes no `--reason` flag. Do **not** write to `.overdeck/continue.json` directly.', step 7 becomes '`metadata.requiresInspection` is a subscription signal for a standing tier-supervisor; it asks nothing of you. Continue with the next ready item.', and old steps 7-11 are deleted; (3) line 73 becomes 'Never batch multiple tasks into a single commit. Each commit's `Item:` trailer is how `pan task done` finds its evidence, and a one-item diff is what makes review and rollback tractable.'; (4) delete the whole '## Jidoka Inspection Gates' section (lines 91-101) so '## Completion' follows the foreman protocol; (5) line 141 becomes '- Do not self-review in place of the pipeline; review runs from the PR after `pan done`.' Keep 'one undifferentiated mode', the 'Never approve, deny, dismiss, or answer permission prompts' sentence, and 'tmux send-keys' verbatim. src/lib/__tests__/role-definitions.test.ts lines 44-66: rename the test to 'defines the work role with the push-before-done item loop and no phase labels' and replace the six assertions at lines 54-59 with: toContain('Item: <item-id>'), toContain('git push -u origin'), toContain('pan task done <ISSUE-ID> <item-id>'), not.toContain('pan inspect'), not.toContain('--reason'), not.toContain('Jidoka'). Leave the 'ships a workflow-injected inspect prompt' test at lines 95-104 alone (w5 removes it). The commit body MUST contain a line starting 'Prompt-Change:' or npm run lint:prompt-trailer fails the branch.
